content.text: Intent
People in the office book meeting rooms for their meetings, and nobody may end up double-booked in the same room. A
Room
is a bookable space with a name, floor, capacity and equipment; a
Booking

reserves one Room for a time window on one day and moves through the status requested → confirmed, or cancelled. The system keeps confirmed Bookings of a Room from ever overlapping and keeps attendee numbers within capacity.
Scope
IN: maintaining Rooms and Bookings, the booking time and capacity rules, confirmation and cancellation, and Notion-style forms for both.

OUT: recurring bookings, time zones (all times are office local time), notifications, calendar integration, approval workflows beyond the status change, and rules on who may book (any signed-in user).
Scenarios
None — keeping the beans' rows through their screens; the ordering rules are requirements.
Requirements
R1: The system SHALL accept a Booking only when its end is after its start and both lie on the same day within 08:00–20:00 (a Booking may end exactly at 20:00).
R2: The system SHALL accept a Booking only when its number of attendees does not exceed the capacity of its Room.
P1: Two confirmed Bookings of the same Room never overlap; Bookings that merely touch (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap.

R3: WHEN a Booking is confirmed, or a confirmed Booking is saved with a changed Room, start or end, IF it would overlap another confirmed Booking of the same Room, THEN the system SHALL refuse the save and leave the Booking unchanged.
A cancelled or requested Booking does not count in the overlap check, so cancelling frees its slot.
R4: WHEN a Booking is created, the system SHALL set its status to requested, and the system SHALL allow the status to become confirmed only from requested.
R5: WHEN a Booking is cancelled, the system SHALL release its slot so that another Booking of the same Room and time can be confirmed.

content.text: Mock:
Screen mock
Form design (both beans' default forms)
Like a Notion page: calm and clean, lots of white space, no heavy borders.
At the top, the room's name or the booking's title, big and bold, with a short grey line under it summarising the essentials ("Floor 3 · 12 seats", or "Atlas · Tue 14 Oct, 10:00 → 11:00").
The booking's status as a small coloured tag next to the title: amber for requested, green for confirmed, grey for cancelled.
Below that, the details as a simple list of rows: the name of each detail on the left in grey, its value on the right, with a thin line between rows.
The room's equipment as coloured tags, like Notion's multi-select.
A booking's time shown as one range, start → end.
The booking's room as a link you can open.
Dependencies
None — no other specs or live entities; the registry and entity catalog hold no Room or Booking, and meetingslotfinder (a standalone computation) does not cover rooms.
Constraints
Considered, none apply: performance, volume, availability, privacy, locale, cost. Authorization and audit are the platform's defaults (any signed-in user; who and when recorded).
Acceptance criteria
A1 (verifies R3, P1): GIVEN Atlas has a confirmed Booking 10:00–11:00, WHEN a Booking of Atlas for 10:30–11:30 is confirmed, the system SHALL refuse it.
A2 (verifies P1, R3): GIVEN Atlas has a confirmed Booking 10:00–11:00, WHEN a Booking of Atlas for 11:00–12:00 is confirmed, the system SHALL accept it.

A3 (verifies R3): WHEN a requested Booking of Atlas for 10:30–11:30 exists beside a confirmed one for 10:00–11:00, the system SHALL allow it to be saved as requested, and WHEN a Booking of a different room for 10:30–11:30 is confirmed, the system SHALL accept it.
A4 (verifies R5, R3): GIVEN Atlas has a confirmed Booking 10:00–11:00, WHEN it is cancelled, the system SHALL accept confirming another Atlas Booking for 10:30–11:30.

A5 (verifies R1): WHEN a Booking is saved for 07:30–09:00, or 19:00–20:30, or 10:00–10:00, or 11:00–10:00, or from 19:00 on one day to 09:00 the next, the system SHALL refuse it; WHEN saved for 08:00–09:00 or 19:00–20:00, the system SHALL accept it.
A6 (verifies R2): GIVEN Atlas has capacity 12, WHEN a Booking of Atlas with 12 attendees is saved, the system SHALL accept it, and WHEN with 13 attendees, the system SHALL refuse it.

A7 (verifies R4): WHEN a new Booking is created, its status SHALL be requested; WHEN a requested Booking is confirmed the system SHALL accept it; WHEN a cancelled Booking is set to confirmed, the system SHALL refuse it.

A8 (verifies R3): GIVEN a confirmed Atlas Booking 10:00–11:00 and another confirmed Atlas Booking 12:00–13:00, WHEN the second is moved to 10:30–11:30, the system SHALL refuse the change and keep 12:00–13:00.
